description: Commits 5-6: client 'Create a Game' / 'My games' in index.html with isolated custom run, jsdom client harness, functions/README.md (deploy checklist) and repo README note. Depends on FEAT-002 (callable) and FEAT-003 (rules).
steps: Apply the design sec 7.1 anchor table to index.html (anchor text, not line numbers; re-grep each anchor first): CSS, two menu items after invitesBtn, #createGame and #myGames overlays before <!-- Start -->, firebase-functions import + functionsClient (us-central1, connectFunctionsEmulator only when hostname is localhost/127.0.0.1 AND ?mqEmulator=1), GAMES const, Cloud object generateGame/listMyGames (never show raw e.message), el map entries, state vars, hideAllOverlays additions (el.createGame, el.myGames), textarea keydown stopPropagation, menu handlers with the pauseGame freeze pattern.

Add the delimited /* MQ-CUSTOM:BEGIN */ ... /* MQ-CUSTOM:END */ region: adaptGame (skip malformed questions, null if < 3 valid, Fisher-Yates shuffled opts copy, topic 'custom', hint/explanation/videoWord), startCustomGame, endCustomRun, nextCustomQuestion, setCreateMenu, COPY table from design 5.3 client copy. Wire makeQuestion, startBattle (battleQuestionsNeeded 1 in custom run), qDelay + explanation display in answerQuestion, level/game-over copy, updateHUD, showMathHelp, openVideo, persistProgress (use customRun.base values so level/best/gems/leaderboard never change), enterGame/onMyStatus/logout/startBtn endCustomRun and menu visibility. All model strings via textContent/createElement, no innerHTML on game data. Double submit blocked by creatingGame + disabled controls; offline degrades to 'workshop closed' copy.

Write functions/test/client.test.js (jsdom 31.0.0) per design sec 9(e): load real index.html + questions.js with runScripts dangerously, stub canvas getContext/requestAnimationFrame/AudioContext/localStorage, inject window.MathQuestCloud bridge forwarding generateGame/listMyGames to the Functions+Firestore emulators via a Node Web SDK client. Cover menu visibility per role/status, overlay coverage via hideAllOverlays, Space in textarea, single callable invocation on double click, refusal/error copy, preview->Play question/options/answer fidelity and shuffled copies, hint/video word, custom-run isolation (record every saveProfile payload; level/best/mega/ultra unchanged through level clear, game over, retry, logout, later regular Play), malformed question skipping, rendered as text. If jsdom cannot run the main script even with stubs, fall back to evaluating only the MQ-CUSTOM block and adaptGame with vm and state plainly in findings which happened.

Create functions/README.md (short: run, test commands, deploy checklist from design sec 12 with correct ORDER: rules+indexes, functions, then merge client; budget alert; service account mq-game-builder and roles; Vertex API enablement; MQ_VERTEX_LOCATION; model deprecation procedure; App Check how-to; rollback; Windows quirks; TTL policies optional; first live smoke test). Add a 3-5 line pointer to README.md at repo root. Do not edit .kiro/steering/project-context.md.
Commit client+harness: 'feat(client): Create a Game and My games with isolated custom runs'; commit docs separately: 'docs(functions): README and deploy checklist'.
acceptance_criteria: client.test.js passes with 0 failures (or states clearly which parts fell back to vm-only evaluation and what stays traced)
All earlier suites still pass: unit, handler, e2e, rules (69)
index.html remains single-file, build-less, with no new innerHTML on game data; hideAllOverlays includes both new overlays; offline/local-only flow untouched
functions/README.md contains deploy order, budget alert, service account roles, rollback
verification: $env:MQ_MOCK_MODEL='1'; firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-mathquest "node --test functions/test/e2e.test.js functions/test/client.test.js"
firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-mathquest "node --test rules-test/rules.test.js" (69 pass)
findings: EXECUTED (emulators, mock model, no live calls): unit 262/262; handler 27/27; e2e 10 + client 12 = 22/22; rules 69/69. client.test.js runs the REAL index.html + questions.js in jsdom 31 (main script runs fine, no vm fallback needed); module block replaced by a window.MathQuestCloud bridge forwarding generateGame/listMyGames to the Functions+Firestore emulators via the Node Web SDK. One harness-only source transform: a read-only window.__mq hook injected right after /* MQ-CUSTOM:END */; timers (setTimeout queue, setInterval no-op), canvas, rAF, window.open are stubbed. Bug found and fixed by the isolation test: endCustomRun's updateHUD re-fired life-milestone mega/ultra gem rewards from leftover custom-run lives; endCustomRun now resets lives/milestones first. Extra beyond design: #gameMsg in My games overlay for the can't-be-played message; listMyGames returns null on failure (UI shows Retry), [] when signed out. TRACED only (not executed): the ~30 lines of Firebase module glue in index.html (getFunctions, httpsCallable, connectFunctionsEmulator hook, listMyGames query construction) and real-browser layout/scrolling/audio; legacy-doc menu case after backfill uses a bridge that returns true. Later steps: functions/README.md holds the deploy checklist; root README has a short pointer; .kiro/steering/project-context.md untouched. Commits: feat(client) and docs(functions); nothing pushed.
